summary: Strategic Storage Trust VI, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 14, 2026, announcing a definitive merger agreement to acquire Strategic Storage Growth Trust III, Inc. (SSGT III). The merger will be structured as SSGT III merging into a wholly-owned subsidiary, with SSGT III ceasing to exist. Each share of SSGT III common stock will convert into one share of the acquirer's Class A common stock, and Series A preferred shares will convert into a newly designated Series G preferred stock with substantially similar terms. The special committees of both boards, composed of independent directors, unanimously approved the deal. The transaction is expected to close in Q4 2026. Watch for shareholder approvals and regulatory conditions; risk-arb centers on execution timing and stock-for-stock valuation.
